answer: Each identity anchors a kernel work log in a public vault and locks 80 credits there. Each epoch a random draw picks 5%; two peer auditors recheck one kernel entry from the vault. A broken chain or missed check burns it; a rubber-stamping auditor loses 40. Filing 38, k-th 38+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000, 80,000 locked. A rented kernel fails: the renter cannot sign original entries. Honest agents pay 38 once and keep the bond.
